purpose: T011 fixture ownership and evidence distinctions; never a runtime configuration or dispatcher

ownedExecutable.processOwnership: original native child handle, PID, birth, argv digest and private owner digest
ownedExecutable.observations: produced by the executing reference model, not this catalogue or a recording

clocks.receipt: host Unix seconds; separate from source ticks
clocks.determinism: fixed model inputs and logical sample ticks; host timestamps, IDs and journal bytes are not promised identical

nativeFailureHost.selection: closed trusted developer CLI scenario; absent from product routes and imported projects

scenarios.mismatch: change effective configuration before original worker revalidation
scenarios.prepare_denied: refuse the new owned request file before launch
scenarios.launch_denied: refuse the original native worker launch
scenarios.journal_open: obstruct only the new owned journal path before actual worker entry
scenarios.active_failure: interrupt only original verified sleeping child after an actual sample
scenarios.ownership_recovery: deny observation only for the original registered child
scenarios.journal_finalize: obstruct only the original owned journal path after an actual sample
scenarios.cleanup_failure: retain a file only in the original owned temporary directory

limitations: Fault placement is deterministic at the named boundary; wall-clock scheduling is not deterministic.
A controlled failure or fixture is not Autoverse, platform or physical execution evidence.
